description: Prepare a custody mode change (ADR-003, decision 5): returns the exact unsigned PLC update and its CID, who signs it (pds: from custodial, after proof of possession of the new keys; user: every other direction), and, when the server needs a new key of its own, the key it reserved.

userRotationDidKey.description: Towards the person (from custodial): the user's new rotation key.

ownerDidKey.description: Towards the person (from custodial): the user's owner key.

pdsRotationDidKey.description: Towards the PDS: the key prepare reserved (returned as pdsRotationDidKey).
The key this server reserved for itself; pass it back to finalize.

possessionText.description: signer = pds: sign this with both new keys (raw or webauthn owner signatures) and pass them to finalize.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Missing or invalid input, or the account is already in that mode.

errors.name: CustodyModeNotAllowed
errors.description: This server does not allow the target mode.

errors.name: NotCustodial
errors.description: This server holds no rotation key for the account.
